pattern: Explain or diagnose the core construct accurately
Apply the method to supplied programme evidence
Produce and defend a professional MERL output

MERL-L1.outcome: Differentiate monitoring evaluation research audit and organisational learning using programme scenarios.
Construct coherent results chains theories of change logframes and indicators from a programme brief.
Diagnose weaknesses in causal logic assumptions measurement and indicator design and propose corrections.

MERL-L2.outcome: Operationalise indicators baselines targets methods samples instruments and data-quality controls.
Analyse trade-offs among measurement designs and data sources for a specified management question.
Quality-assure an operational M&E plan and defend its fitness for implementation.

MERL-L3.outcome: Clean transform summarise and visualise programme data using Excel and Python.
Apply descriptive and inferential methods and distinguish statistical results from substantive interpretation.
Produce reproducible analyses dashboards and decision-ready performance briefs.

MERL-L4.outcome: Formulate evaluation questions and analyse design threats causal assumptions and evidence requirements.
Select and defend evaluation impact and mixed-methods designs appropriate to programme constraints.
Produce an evaluation design analysis report and management response package.

MERL-L5.outcome: Evaluate institutional MERL governance data systems analytical capability and evidence-use maturity.
Architect integrated MERL systems incorporating strategy governance spatial predictive and AI-enabled evidence.
Lead learning adaptation and executive evidence communication using defensible decision intelligence.

verification: Every module inherits its level outcomes and instantiates them against its specific subject and professional output.
